commits_data.message:
SMB: dissect_smb_file_pipe_local_remote (guint)

dissect_smb_file_pipe_local_remote

Add subdissectors dissect_qfi_SMB_FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFO and
dissect_qfi_SMB_FILE_PIPE_REMOTE_INFO for
FilePipeLocalInformation and PipeRemoteInformation, respectively.

SMB: dissect_smb_file_pipe_local_remote (_flag)

Removed "_flag" from three of the filters per Alexis'
recommendation..

Per Ander's suggestion, changed several proto_tree_add_uint()s to
proto_add_item()s.

Per Gerald's suggestion, I changed guint16 to uint16_t.
